name: copper-thistle-restaurant
description: Copper Thistle — a restaurant website template by Allen Code Co.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "e2e/**/*.ts" playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts tailwind.config.ts postcss.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" "tests/**/*.{ts,tsx}" "scripts/**/*.mjs" "e2e/**/*.ts" playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts tailwind.config.ts postcss.config.js eslint.config.js
